object.script: c = 120 s = {} sum = 0 flag = 0 function onTick() if flag == 1 then b = a a = input.getNumber(1) A = b - a if (#s) < c then table.insert(s, A) sum = sum + A else sum = sum - s[1] table.remove(s, 1) table.insert(s, A) sum = sum + A end output.setNumber(1, -(sum / #s * 60)) else a = input.getNumber(1) flag = 1 end end
